description_zh: Waymo AV 在前方因检测到紧急车辆警笛而减速，后方丰田普锐斯未能及时制动导致追尾，测试后车能否应对前车减速避免碰撞。

source_snippets: The Waymo AV was traveling westbound on 17th Street when it detected a siren from a nearby emergency vehicle. As the Waymo AV slowed, a passenger vehicle made contact with the rear of the Waymo AV.
evidence.reason: 两辆移动车辆，后车追尾前车减速，具有测试价值。选择后车作为 ego，前车作为 NPC 减速，符合 front_brake 块。
